headline: Pressure on the Leu Cost BNR 4.8 Billion Euros in Reserves in September
summary: Romania's foreign exchange reserves fell by 4.8 billion euros in September amid pressure on the leu, according to National Bank of Romania data. The figures were reported by CursDeGuvernare.ro.
why: Central bank reserves are used to defend the currency, so a sharp drop often signals intervention against depreciation pressure.
